description: Branch A, deciding variant: omission versus explicit Null and Empty for an optional argument, supplied through a declared Long parameter p. Asks Round(2.5, p), Mid('abcd', 2, p), Left('abcd', p) and InStr(p, 'abcd', 'c') with p = Null, Empty and 0 (each on a fresh temporary QueryDef, p assigned and read back, opened as a snapshot), next to the omitted forms Round(2.5), Mid('abcd', 2) and InStr('abcd', 'c'). Follow-up probe (status F) for Branch A; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
